pick.headline: Israeli commandos abduct Hizballah's Sheikh Obeid
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of July 28, 1989, carried the clandestine Voice of the Mountain and Paris AFP on the Israeli helicopter raid on Jibshit that seized Shaykh Abd-al-Karim Ubayd, AFP noting his links to the kidnapping of Lt. Col. Higgins.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 144, 28 July 1989
evidence.snippet: …raeli military force this morning carried out a quick landing operation in Jibshit. An Israeli helicopter landed in Wadi al-Wata and Israeli troops entered Jibshit where they burst into the home of Shaykh ‘Abd-al-Karim ‘Ubayd and abducted him and two other citizens, Ahmad ‘Ubayd and Hashim Fahs. The Israelis also tied up Shaykh ‘Abd-al-Karim’s wife and locked her up in a room. Before withdrawing, the Israeli force killed citizen Mazin Abu-Za…

alternates.headline: Los Angeles Olympics open without the Soviet bloc
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of July 30, 1984, listed Moscow's reportage on the Los Angeles Olympics: games "unrepresentative" of world champions, an opening ceremony in the "worst Hollywood tradition," alleged secret US funding of foreign athletes and Libya's withdrawal.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, Vol. III No. 147, 30 July 1984
evidence.snippet: …A ZHIZN 21 Jul] SPEEEEEEEES WORLD & REGIONAL ISSUES Weekly ‘International Observers Roundtable' [Gerasimov, Shishlin, Levin] Anniversary of Helsinki Final Act U.S. Elections Space Talks Proposal Reportage on Los Angeles Olympic Games Unrepresentative of World Champions Ceremony in Worst Hollywood Tradition [Beglov, Ustimenko ] Dangerous Situation Reported U.S. Secretly Funding Foreign Athletes Libya Withdraws From Games U.S. Calls Libyans Secu…
